experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2298:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4375:./reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4385:./reassess/r_3.md:4249:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:16635:../../decisions.md:4603:**决策**: **纯 CLIP 文本部位路线=死路**(语义冗余)。step2 的新 CLIP 接法必须带 global 没有的真信息(CLIP 视觉特征/遮挡推理/ID 级原型)。理想判据(用户定):baseline 58 → +CLIP 59(CLIP 单独过坎)→ +pose-CLIP 60;现状是 CLIP 单独那步=0。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2321:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4609:./reassess/r_3.md:7785:./reassess/r_3.md:2244:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2185:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2326:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4615:./reassess/r_3.md:7829:./reassess/r_3.md:2469:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_24.md:403:审查只拦实质问题：代码正确性的错误、数据泄漏、评测协议前后不一致、变量没隔离干净、比较不公平。操作上、文档上的小问题，可以记成待办，但不要拦。结论写进 `experiments/expNNN/review-codex.md`。通过时要明确写“无实质问题”“approve”“审查通过”或“放行”。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2336:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4625:./reassess/r_3.md:7867:./reassess/r_3.md:2890:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:1062:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1526:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2346:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4635:./reassess/r_3.md:7901:./reassess/r_3.md:3351:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2352:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4643:./reassess/r_3.md:7956:./reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2354:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4645:./reassess/r_3.md:7958:./reassess/r_3.md:4101:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:169:  `full_map.detach()` 的位置足以切断梯度，但它发生在 f_full Swin late stages 和 `layer4` 已经执行之后。也就是说 degraded `rec_only` pass 仍计算了 f_full 激活并消耗随机层 RNG；只是这些结果不进 loss、不更新 f_full BNNeck/权重。这是注释“cheap / no f_full grad graph built”的夸大，不是梯度泄漏。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2357:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4824:./reassess/r_3.md:9614:analyses/deep_28.txt:77:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2361:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4891:./reassess/r_3.md:11148:reviews/deep_19.md:625:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2801:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1641:reassess/r_3.md:3615:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3475:cheap kill-switch：按 SMPL 可见性做 token dropout 或 surface dropout，小规模训练 5 到 10 个 epoch。必须证明它比随机擦除、随机 token dropout 更能改善极端视角子集，否则只是普通增广。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2805:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1645:reassess/r_3.md:3621:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3520:区别：它和 AOANet 的区别是不用 2D 自适应分块讲遮挡，而是用 SMPL 表面可见性定义哪些证据可比较。它和 `Beyond geometry` 的区别是避开完整 UVTexture 和重排序，重点做低清航拍到地面里的可观测性约束，目标是训练出单 embedding 或表面 token embedding。  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2815:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1655:reassess/r_3.md:3646:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:362:**部位/掩码方向终审判负**（exp022-026，约30次训练，账本在 results.md + decisions.md#44）：抗遮挡重加权、构造掩码监督(软/硬)、语言部位分支(含忠实LGPA-D)全部在强主干上不成立。三路codex法医结论：PSG的姿态接地是LGPA-D全部集成选择的承重墙，无姿态版必败。唯一幸存=遮挡物贴图增广(Swin +0.83/+1.10)，但有先例非方法级。exp026确认种子(no-detach s1/s2)在 hyy 跑完即封档，不阻塞选向。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1766:reassess/r_3.md:3895:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3386:我会优先押第 1 个和第 2 个。它们的问题层面更清楚，也最能把团队的 aerial-ground 和 SMPL 基建变成别人不容易复刻的机制。第 3 个有潜力，但依赖视频或稳定 SMPL 质量。第 4 个成本最低，适合作为辅助机制，不适合单独当 B 类主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2935:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1776:reassess/r_3.md:3907:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3460:我会优先押第 1 个和第 2 个。它们的问题层面更清楚，也最能把团队的 aerial-ground 和 SMPL 基建变成别人不容易复刻的机制。第 3 个有潜力，但依赖视频或稳定 SMPL 质量。第 4 个成本最低，适合作为辅助机制，不适合单独当 B 类主贡献。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2973:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2981:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1822:reassess/r_3.md:4018:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2702:我最建议优先试候选 1。它同时占“问题新”和“机制新”，和这批论文的切开点清楚，也最能发挥你们已经打通的 SMPL 基建。候选 3 是问题层面最像 B 类故事的备选，但需要一点真实歧义证据支撑，否则容易变成普通鲁棒损失。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2983:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1824:reassess/r_3.md:4020:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2744:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2989:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1830:reassess/r_3.md:4027:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2774:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2999:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1845:reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3107:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4158:reassess/r_2.md:1001:reassess/r_3.md:1960:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/strategic_pivot.sh:21:ROLES[2]="角色=**转向者**。假设 avg>MaxSim 这个 hook 是死胡同(反复 reduce to avg)。团队资产=SMPL人体几何基建 + Swin/SOLIDER backbone + CARGO/AG-ReID.v2 数据 + 遮挡/VI-ReID 历史。用 22 招式 + 联网, 提 1-2 个**换问题**的 B 类方向(可以离开 avg>MaxSim 甚至离开纯 aerial-ground), 每个带: 触发观察/重定义/机制怎么长/廉价 kill-switch/撞车核查。重点用团队独有的 SMPL 几何当差异化(但记住 exp333 证 SMPL-β≈random, 别再走那条)。务实中文。"

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3181:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4234:reassess/r_2.md:1241:reassess/r_3.md:2779:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:45:./strategic_pivot.sh:22:ROLES[3]="角色=**残酷否决者**。不留情面判断: 整个 CARGO/aerial-ground empirical 方向, 对一篇 B 类**方法稿**(不是 benchmark/不是 backbone), 是不是已经是死胡同?证据: 遮挡5死角→转empirical→OVLI/OVP/MaxSim/containment 又全倒, method 始终不成形, 只有 avg 这个平凡 baseline 撑着。联网核查 aerial-ground ReID 2024-2026 现状(还有没有 method 空间, 还是已被 GSAlign/VDT/AG-VPReID 这代占满)。如果是死胡同, 明确说'该放弃换战场', 并指出团队最该回到哪类问题(基于它的真实资产: SMPL几何/Swin/遮挡历史)。如果不是死胡同, 指出唯一还值得赌的点。务实中文, 别和稀泥。"

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3189:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4242:reassess/r_2.md:1264:reassess/r_3.md:2823:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:655:./analyses/deep_25.txt:37:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3268:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4321:reassess/r_2.md:1602:reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3270:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4323:reassess/r_2.md:1612:reassess/r_3.md:3510:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3331:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4332:reassess/r_2.md:1641:reassess/r_3.md:3615:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3475:cheap kill-switch：按 SMPL 可见性做 token dropout 或 surface dropout，小规模训练 5 到 10 个 epoch。必须证明它比随机擦除、随机 token dropout 更能改善极端视角子集，否则只是普通增广。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3286:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4339:reassess/r_2.md:1655:reassess/r_3.md:3646:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:362:**部位/掩码方向终审判负**（exp022-026，约30次训练，账本在 results.md + decisions.md#44）：抗遮挡重加权、构造掩码监督(软/硬)、语言部位分支(含忠实LGPA-D)全部在强主干上不成立。三路codex法医结论：PSG的姿态接地是LGPA-D全部集成选择的承重墙，无姿态版必败。唯一幸存=遮挡物贴图增广(Swin +0.83/+1.10)，但有先例非方法级。exp026确认种子(no-detach s1/s2)在 hyy 跑完即封档，不阻塞选向。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3287:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4340:reassess/r_2.md:1656:reassess/r_3.md:3665:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:687:target individuals among multiple non-overlapping camera viewpoints.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3332:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4385:reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3336:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4389:reassess/r_2.md:1822:reassess/r_3.md:4018:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2702:我最建议优先试候选 1。它同时占“问题新”和“机制新”，和这批论文的切开点清楚，也最能发挥你们已经打通的 SMPL 基建。候选 3 是问题层面最像 B 类故事的备选，但需要一点真实歧义证据支撑，否则容易变成普通鲁棒损失。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3387:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5022:reassess/r_3.md:2759:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_17.md:6450:4. 证据闭环：关键不是只报最终涨点，而是分别证明 DMM 和 CDCN 的角色。消融显示 DMM 提升抗遗忘但会牺牲适应性，CDCN 提升适应性并改善记忆，二者组合互相补偿。另一个关键证据是 DMM 只放在重放阶段最好，放在适应阶段会污染相机认知节点。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5043:reassess/r_3.md:2823:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:655:./analyses/deep_25.txt:37:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3541:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5176:reassess/r_3.md:3476:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:291:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3551:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5186:reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3689:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5333:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3693:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5337:reassess/r_3.md:4018:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2702:我最建议优先试候选 1。它同时占“问题新”和“机制新”，和这批论文的切开点清楚，也最能发挥你们已经打通的 SMPL 基建。候选 3 是问题层面最像 B 类故事的备选，但需要一点真实歧义证据支撑，否则容易变成普通鲁棒损失。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3824:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_28.txt:77:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3825:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_10.md:493:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3866:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:1:# 实验 exp359: LM-ReID (Lattice-Marginalized ReID)
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3868:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3875:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:36:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3887:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:96:6. eval（**test.py 不用 train.py**）：LM-ReID(K marg) vs single / TTA / frozen-ensemble，h=16/24/32 分报，LEG/LOTG/PRF。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3888:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:1:# Claude Broad Review — exp359 LM-ReID 训练脚本
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3889:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:5:**范围**: `cvpb_lm_reid_train.py` 全文 + `design.md` + 模型接口源码验证 + 与 frozen baseline 的对照隔离
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:29:- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3894:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:43:逐行审查 + 源码接口验证完成，4 处问题已修（KL 方向 / AMP / 稳健 out 取值 / scaler backward）。代码正确、对照隔离干净（lattice 生成 byte-identical 复用、eval 复用 kill-switch）、过线判据明确、诚实判死路径清楚。**审查通过**，可进 smoke + 训练（仍需 Codex 独立审通过）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3895:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:4:No Critical runtime/shape/device bug found, but I would not launch this as-is because two training-design issues can invalidate exp359.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3896:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:8:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173): per-sample RNG is reset from `seed + idx`, so each image gets the same height and same lattice variants every epoch. This contradicts design “每图每 iter 采样 M variants”.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3897:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:11:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118): default `M=2` plus `mode = j % 3` trains only canonical + bbox-shift/bilinear. It does not train sub-pixel phase or zoom/antialias axes despite the method claim.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3898:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:12:  Fix: make real training default `M>=4` at minimum, or sample perturbation mode/kernel for each noncanonical variant; if keeping `L_adv`, store actual lattice labels.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. With `0.02-0.05`, the adversarial signal becomes `λ²`.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. This treats other variants of the same image as positives and is not exactly the stated per-lattice-slot formula.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3901:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:20:- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3909:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3910:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:33:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3911:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3912:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:40:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3913:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3914:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:62:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3917:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:65:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3918:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:71:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:89:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3920:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:95:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3921:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:104:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3922:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:108:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3923:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3924:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:110:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:112:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4403:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4493:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1920:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:132:2. **vs-#false**：控制“多试几次总会撞上更好结果”的假象，可以用 shuffled lattice labels、非 lattice photometric variants、或 same-K random harmless variants。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4494:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1921:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:136:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4495:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1923:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:140:RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery，用 feature distillation/filtering 去掉 resolution-related feature。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871)) 它占了“resolution-invariant distillation”，但没有占 lattice intervention。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4545:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4556:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3030:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1879:reassess/r_3.md:4279:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:21900:  `full_map.detach()` 的位置足以切断梯度，但它发生在 f_full Swin late stages 和 `layer4` 已经执行之后。也就是说 degraded `rec_only` pass 仍计算了 f_full 激活并消耗随机层 RNG；只是这些结果不进 loss、不更新 f_full BNNeck/权重。这是注释“cheap / no f_full grad graph built”的夸大，不是梯度泄漏。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4594:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。

It does not train sub-pixel phase or zoom/antialias axes despite the method claim.

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4605:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. With `0.02-0.05`, the adversarial signal becomes `λ²`.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4606:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. This treats other variants of the same image as positives and is not exactly the stated per-lattice-slot formula.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4607:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3901:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:20:- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

    def _make_random_block_views(self, base_tensor, H, W):
        """Random block masking control for PCVT (exp150).

        Divides image into 8x4 grid (32 blocks), randomly assigns half to A, half to B.
        Guarantees ~50/50 coverage and perfect complementarity (A ∩ B = ∅).
        """
        block_h = H // 8  # 32 pixels per block vertically
        block_w = W // 4  # 32 pixels per block horizontally
        n_blocks = 8 * 4  # 32 blocks total

        # Random permutation, first half → A, second half → B
        perm = torch.randperm(n_blocks)
        set_a = set(perm[:n_blocks // 2].tolist())

        drop_a = torch.zeros(H, W, dtype=torch.bool)
        drop_b = torch.zeros(H, W, dtype=torch.bool)

        for idx in range(n_blocks):
            row = idx // 4
            col = idx % 4
            y1 = row * block_h
            y2 = min(y1 + block_h, H)
            x1 = col * block_w
            x2 = min(x1 + block_w, W)
            if idx in set_a:
                drop_a[y1:y2, x1:x2] = True
            else:
                drop_b[y1:y2, x1:x2] = True

        view_a = base_tensor.clone()
        view_b = base_tensor.clone()
        view_a[:, drop_a] = self.pcvt_fill_value
        view_b[:, drop_b] = self.pcvt_fill_value

        mga = float(drop_a.float().mean().item())
        mgb = float(drop_b.float().mean().item())

        meta = {
            'pcvt_cov_a': torch.tensor(0.5, dtype=torch.float32),
            'pcvt_cov_b': torch.tensor(0.5, dtype=torch.float32),
            'pcvt_cov_u': torch.tensor(1.0, dtype=torch.float32),
            'pcvt_ovr': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
            'pcvt_mga': torch.tensor(mga, dtype=torch.float32),
            'pcvt_mgb': torch.tensor(mgb, dtype=torch.float32),
            'pcvt_gca': torch.tensor(float(n_blocks // 2), dtype=torch.float32),
            'pcvt_gcb': torch.tensor(float(n_blocks - n_blocks // 2), dtype=torch.float32),
            'pcvt_fb': torch.tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32),
        }
        return view_a, view_b, meta

def occlude_with_objects(im, occluders, n=1, min_overlap=0.2, max_overlap=0.6):
    """Paste random occluders onto image with alpha blending.

    Args:
        im: numpy array (H, W, 3), will be modified in-place
        occluders: list of RGBA patches from load_occluders()
        n: max number of occluders to paste
        min_overlap/max_overlap: fraction of image area covered by occluder

    Returns:
        im: modified image (same object, modified in-place)
    """
    result = im.copy()
    width_height = np.asarray([im.shape[1], im.shape[0]])
    im_area = im.shape[1] * im.shape[0]
    count = np.random.randint(1, n + 1)

    for _ in range(count):
        occluder = random.choice(occluders)
        occluder_area = occluder.shape[1] * occluder.shape[0]
        if occluder_area < 1:
            continue
        overlap = random.uniform(min_overlap, max_overlap)
        scale_factor = math.sqrt(overlap * im_area / occluder_area)
        occluder = _resize_by_factor(occluder, scale_factor)
        center = np.random.uniform([0, 0], width_height)
        _paste_over(im_src=occluder, im_dst=result, center=center)

    return result


def pose_aware_occlude(im, occluders, keypoints, scores,
                       n=1, min_overlap=0.2, max_overlap=0.5,
                       score_threshold=0.3, jitter_std=30.0):
    """Paste occluders at pose-guided locations (body regions).

    Instead of random placement, centers occluders near visible keypoints
    to simulate realistic body-part occlusion.

    Args:
        im: numpy array (H, W, 3)
        occluders: list of RGBA patches
        keypoints: (17, 2) array of keypoint x,y coordinates (person 0)
        scores: (17,) array of keypoint confidence scores
        n: max number of occluders
        min_overlap/max_overlap: fraction of image area covered
        score_threshold: minimum keypoint confidence to consider
        jitter_std: standard deviation of Gaussian offset from keypoint center
    """
    result = im.copy()
    im_area = im.shape[1] * im.shape[0]
    count = np.random.randint(1, n + 1)

    # Find valid keypoints (visible body parts)
    valid_mask = scores > score_threshold
    valid_kps = keypoints[valid_mask]  # (K, 2) where K = number of valid kps

    if len(valid_kps) == 0:
        # Fallback to random placement if no valid keypoints
        return occlude_with_objects(im, occluders, n, min_overlap, max_overlap)

    for _ in range(count):
        occluder = random.choice(occluders)
        occluder_area = occluder.shape[1] * occluder.shape[0]
        if occluder_area < 1:
            continue
        overlap = random.uniform(min_overlap, max_overlap)
        scale_factor = math.sqrt(overlap * im_area / occluder_area)
        occluder = _resize_by_factor(occluder, scale_factor)

        # Sample center from a random visible keypoint + Gaussian jitter
        kp_idx = random.randint(0, len(valid_kps) - 1)

**短判决**
PLBOA 的效果是真的，而且机理比“普通增强”干净：它在补 Occluded-Duke 的下半身遮挡 train-test gap。  
但把它包装成“pose-guided + 解剖先验 + 真实遮挡物”的 B 类主方法，风险很高。我现在判：**不如 LM-ReID 6.5，PLBOA 主方法约 4/10；PLBOA 支撑一篇 controlled study 约 5.5-6/10。**

**(a) +0.9 vs random ROA 的机理排序**

1. **下半身遮挡分布匹配，最可信**  
你 exp157 的设计依据很强：train 下半身低可见 1.8%，query 24.4%。random ROA 把遮挡预算撒到全图，PLBOA 把预算打到真实 gap 上。  
Kill-switch：按 query 遮挡部位分桶，PLBOA 增益必须主要集中在 lower-body occluded bucket；clean/upper-body bucket 不应同等上涨。  
信心：8/10。

2. **pose 定位有用，但不是泛泛 pose-aware placement 有用**  
你自己的 PA-ROA 对 random ROA 是 -0.2/-0.3，body-random 也负。说明“贴到人体/关键点附近”不是核心。核心是 hip 以下这个解剖先验。  
Kill-switch：fixed bottom-half RPE-style，不用 pose，只按图像下半部贴真实物体。如果它追平 PLBOA，pose 定位贡献死亡。  
信心：6/10。

3. **VOC 真实物体纹理解释 ROA 有效，但不能单独解释 PLBOA > ROA**  
DPEFormer 2024 已把真实遮挡物增强 ROA 做成模块，并在 ablation 里显示 ROA 明显强于 RE/CutPaste。FED、DPL-ReID、DPM++ 也都走真实/转移遮挡增强路线。PLBOA 和 ROA 都用真实物体，所以 +0.9 更像“打到下半身”而不是“真实纹理”。  
Kill-switch：PLBOA-VOC vs PLBOA-gray/random-texture，同面积同位置；若差距 <0.3 mAP，真实语义不是主因。  
信心：5/10。

4. **同步修改 keypoint visibility/heatmap 可能是隐性关键**  
当前 ROA 只改图像；PLBOA 还把被挡 keypoint 的 score/visibility/heatmap 清零。这对 GCN/pose branch 是结构一致性信号。  
Kill-switch：PLBOA-pixel-only vs PLBOA-pixel+visibility-zero。如果两者无差，visibility 同步不是机理。  
信心：6/10。

**(b) 能否上升成 B 类新方法/新原理**

单独 PLBOA：**不建议当主创新，基本判死**。外部 novelty 太挤：

- DPEFormer 2024 已有 ROA，用真实物体 mask 模拟遮挡，并把它作为 occluded ReID 组件。
- DPL-ReID 2026 明确包含 RWOA，即 real-world occlusion augmentation。
- DPM++ 2026 用 saliency-guided patch transfer，从原图转移遮挡区域，目标也是构造更真实的遮挡样本。
- 本地文献库里的 RMPSNet 2026 PDF 甚至已经有 RPE：lower-body-prior erasure，直接撞“下半身遮挡分布不是均匀的”这个叙事。

如果硬要救，不能叫“PLBOA”。必须升级成 **distribution-targeted occlusion risk minimization**：先估计部署集遮挡分布，再按 body-region × occluder-type 合成、重加权、DRO 或 curriculum，并证明比 ROA/RPE/RWOA/SPT 更稳。这个才有一点方法味，但也很危险。

Kill-switch：  
- fixed bottom-half RPE 追平 PLBOA，pose-guided claim 死。  
- DPEFormer-style ROA + lower-body probability 调参追平，method novelty 死。  
- 只在 Occluded-Duke 有效，Market/Occ-ReID/Occ-PTrack 或跨域不稳定，general principle 死。  
- PLBOA 增益不集中在下半身遮挡 query，distribution-gap story 死。  
信心：7/10 判它不适合主方法。

**(c) 更像什么论文**

更诚实的定位是：**What Helps Occluded ReID? A controlled training-side study**。  
这里 PLBOA 是最强真有效模块，OA-SD/PAA/LGPA/ROA 等作为单独增量考古，反而能形成一篇有价值的诊断论文：哪些模块是真的，哪些是总账误导，为什么真实遮挡增强胜过模型小模块。

但这种论文要过 B 类，必须有三件事：

1. 多 seed、同 scaffold、同 baseline 的干净总账。
2. 至少两个数据集或跨域验证，证明不是 Occluded-Duke 定制。
3. per-bucket 分析，说明“下半身遮挡 gap”而不是“又一个增强 trick”。

**与 LM-ReID 6.5 对比**  
LM-ReID 更强。它有“sampling-lattice uncertainty”这个隐藏变量，有零训练 intervention，有 vs TTA 的硬切开点。PLBOA 目前是强 recipe + 好诊断，不是同等级的新问题重定义。

最终分数：

| 方向 | 分数 | 结论 |
|---|---:|---|
| PLBOA 单模块主方法 | 3.5-4/10 | 判死 |
| “pose+解剖+真实遮挡物”原则 | 4.5/10 | 除非升级成分布风险建模 |
| controlled study 论文 | 5.5-6/10 | 可做，但要多数据集和分桶证据 |
| 是否 > LM-ReID 6.5 | 否，信心 8/10 | LM-ReID 仍更像 B 类主赌注 |

参考来源：DPEFormer ROA [arXiv 2402.10435](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.10435)，FED [arXiv 2112.08740](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.08740)，DPM++ [arXiv 2605.06637](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06637)，DPL-ReID [arXiv 2605.19527](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19527)。
